meta.title: 12-02-2025 — Forwarded Unredacted Internal Email incl. Third‑Party Data (Paul Double)

claim_summary: On 12 Feb 2025, the OIC is alleged to have forwarded an internal police email without appropriate redaction, exposing third‑party personal data (Paul Double).
key_points: Nature of issue: forwarding of an internal police email externally without redaction.
Third‑party named: Paul Double (personal data included).
Potential harms: unlawful disclosure, loss of confidence, evidential contamination risk.
alleged_breaches: UK GDPR / DPA 2018 — lawfulness, fairness, transparency (Art 5(1)(a)); purpose limitation (5(1)(b)); data minimisation (5(1)(c)); integrity/confidentiality (5(1)(f))
DPA 2018 Part 3 (Law Enforcement Processing) — s.35 principles, s.44 security of processing

contradictions.claim: Internal email forwarded externally with third‑party personal data unredacted.
